old:
\/ /\ ~cancel
          /\ sock = "connecting"

          /\ UNCHANGED <<sock, th, calls, res, cancel, blocking>>

          /\ sock = "connecting"
          /\ calls' = calls + 1
          /\ th' = "done"

          /\ UNCHANGED <<sock, cancel, blocking, waitedCanceled>>
